national_news.title: PM Modi Launches Projects Worth ₹13,000 Crore in Chennai
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for development projects worth ₹13,000 crore in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

Key initiatives include the ₹4,900 crore Chennai Metro extension featuring a 3.7-km double-decker driverless-capable corridor, port expansion at Kamarajar Port, and five redeveloped railway stations under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme.
Dedicated the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre at IIT Madras, an initiative aimed at mapping over 100 human brains into 3D cellular-resolution atlases across human lifespans.

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana Completes First Year
bullets: The Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PMDDKY) completed one year of implementation across 100 selected Aspirational Agricultural Districts.

The six-year initiative converges 36 Central schemes across 11 Ministries and Departments, along with State and private sector interventions, to boost productivity, irrigation, credit access, and post-harvest infrastructure.
Operates under a three-tier implementation structure and utilizes 121 indicators across District Action Plans to track progress.

national_news.title: India Reiterate Stand on J&K and Counter Pakistan at United Nations
bullets: India exercised its Right of Reply in the Fourth Committee of the UN General Assembly in New York, slamming Pakistan for spreading falsehoods about Jammu and Kashmir.

MP Mahima Kumari Mewar highlighted human rights violations by Pakistan in illegally occupied areas, while MP Priya Saroj addressed the Sixth Committee emphasizing India's zero-tolerance for misconduct by UN personnel.
India's Permanent Mission to the UN Conference on Disarmament warned Pakistan that nuclear threats will not deter India from responding to terrorist attacks.

national_news.title: CAQM Reviews Stubble Burning Prevention Measures in Punjab Hotspots
bullets: A high-level team of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) reviewed paddy stubble burning prevention measures in Amritsar and Tarn Taran districts of Punjab.
The review focused on effective in-situ and ex-situ utilization of paddy straw, deployment of Crop Residue Management (CRM) machinery, and establishing industrial supply chains for balers.
District administrations have set up control rooms, help desks, and deployed nodal officers for field patrolling to curb winter air pollution in the NCR.

national_news.title: India's Lighthouse Transformation and Maritime Tourism Growth
bullets: India boasts a coastline stretching over 11,000 km with 205 lighthouses, of which 75 have been developed as major tourism destinations by the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL).
Lighthouse tourism surged from about 4 lakh visitors in 2014 to 18.63 lakh in 2024–25, supported by a newly launched common digital ticketing portal.
All lighthouses in India are now solar-powered and equipped with 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations for enhanced maritime safety and situational awareness.

national_news.title: India Reaffirms J&K Stance and Addresses Security Issues at UN Committees
bullets: India exercised its Right of Reply at the Fourth Committee of the UN General Assembly in New York, with MP Mahima Kumari Mewar reiterating that Jammu and Kashmir remains an integral and inalienable part of India.

MP Priya Saroj delivered India's national statement at the 81st session of the UNGA Sixth Committee, emphasizing a zero-tolerance policy towards misconduct and criminal conduct by UN officials and mission experts.

At the UNGA First Committee on Disarmament, Senior Adviser Anmol Sher Bedi highlighted India's self-defense actions under Operation Sindoor and warned against using nuclear threats to shield cross-border terrorism.

national_news.title: India Modernizes Lighthouses and Promotes Maritime Tourism Infrastructure
bullets: Under the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL), India has developed 75 out of 205 lighthouses along its 11,000 km coastline as tourist destinations, boosting visitor count from 4 lakh in 2014 to 18.63 lakh in 2024–25.
All lighthouses in India are now 100% solar-powered, transitioning from traditional fuel lamps to energy-efficient LED flashers and modern navigational equipment.

To strengthen maritime safety, 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations aligned with the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) have been set up at lighthouse locations.

national_news.title: Transformation of Indian Lighthouses into Tourism and Modern Navigational Hubs
bullets: India has over 11,000 km of coastline and 205 lighthouses, with 75 lighthouses developed as prominent tourism destinations featuring museums, pathways, and gardens.
Lighthouse tourism witnessed a significant rise from 4 lakh visitors in 2014 to 18.63 lakh visitors in 2024-25.
All Indian lighthouses are now solar-powered, and 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations have been installed under the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Unveils Ease of Doing Business Act 2026 to Accelerate Industrialisation
bullets: Bihar government notified the Bihar Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026, on October 9, 2026, to overhaul industrial governance.
The framework replaces permission-based administration with self-certification, time-bound approvals, and a single authority for investment clearances.
Aimed at dismantling bureaucratic red tape, the initiative seeks to attract fresh investments, accelerate industrialisation, and generate employment in the state.

bihar_news.title: Decision on Maa Sita Women's University Deferred Until Post-MLC Polls in Bihar
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister instructed Higher Education Minister Sanjay Singh Tiger to delay any final decision regarding the proposed Maa Sita Women's University.
Consultations with relevant stakeholders and further administrative actions will commence only after the conclusion of the ongoing Bihar Legislative Council (MLC) election process.
A formal meeting with stakeholders will be convened to review suggestions and feedback before finalising the university's establishment.

bihar_news.title: BIADA MD Inspects Patliputra Industrial Area and Directs Action Against Encroachments
bullets: Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority (BIADA) Managing Director Naveen Kumar inspected the Patliputra Industrial Area in Patna on October 10, 2026.
Directed time-bound actions against encroachments, unauthorised constructions, sanitation lapses, and illegal vehicle parking on BIADA land.
Announced the implementation of an access control system at all entry gates to regulate private vehicle movement and improve infrastructure maintenance.

bihar_news.title: Prabhat Kumar Sinha Appointed Chairman of ICC Bihar State Council
bullets: The Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC) appointed Prabhat Kumar Sinha as the new Chairman of its Bihar State Council.
The announcement was made by ICC President Parthiv Neotia during the Chamber's Annual General Meeting held in Kolkata.
The appointment aims to boost industrial growth, attract private investments, strengthen MSMEs and startups, and enhance industry-government collaboration in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Upholds Promotees' Seniority and Gradation List in Bihar Police Service
bullets: The Supreme Court upheld the validity of the gradation list and the seniority of promotee officers in the Bihar Police Service based on continuous officiation.
The court clarified that Rule 3 of the Bihar Police Service (Recruitment) Rules does not impose a fixed quota and permits filling more than half of the vacancies with promotees.
The judgment set aside the Patna High Court's earlier ruling and dismissed the related writ petitions challenging the State's executive power to regulate public services.

bihar_news.title: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi Highlights NEP 2020 at Student Event in Bihar
bullets: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi stated that education must go beyond rote learning and securing jobs, focusing instead on innovation for a developed India by 2047.
He addressed an event in Bihar felicitating winners of the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' painting and speech competitions.
The initiative witnessed participation from students across 95,195 government and private schools spanning all 38 districts of Bihar.

bihar_news.title: ICC Bihar State Council Focuses on Accelerating State Industrial Growth
bullets: Newly appointed ICC Bihar State Council Chairman Prabhat Kumar Sinha prioritized facilitating investments and strengthening MSMEs and startups in Bihar.
The council aims to act as a bridge between policymakers and industry representatives to improve the ease of doing business and technology adoption.
The initiative aligns with Bihar's broader economic transformation goals to expand manufacturing capabilities and generate employment opportunities.
